saw_lines: Merino buyers compare fabric, fit and how it feels in heat, then rebuy the shirt they liked last season.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, before a buyer reaches the product.
Your 30 ads include no video, so buyers never see merino in motion. Shoot three short videos of the shirt on a climb and test them against your best image.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 20 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 ads is a video, so buyers never see the merino stretch or dry on a trail. Shoot three short videos of the shirt worn on a climb and run each against your best image ad.

0 of 28 copy ads carry a proof number, so a buyer comparing merino brands has nothing to weigh your shirts against. Collect one real number, like orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.
0 of 28 ads carry an offer or discount, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put one first order offer on the creative of every new ad and name it in the opening line.
Your 28 copy ads open with 26 different stories, and the biggest opener runs on only 2 ads, so no hook gets enough runs to prove itself. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch from them.

ads_1: Short merino in motion videos, with the two best hook stories as openers
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and YouTube
